overview: The City Council and School Committee held a joint meeting to review the FY 2027 budget development schedule and receive a financial update from the Chief Financial Officer. Discussion focused on closing a projected $5 million gap required for level services and clarifying the long-term status of the school stabilization fund.

items.title: FY 2027 Budget Process and Schedule
items.summary: President Zac Bears and Member Paul Ruseau outlined the FY 2027 budget development timelines for the city and school district, noting the May 31 deadline for the Mayor's formal budget submission.

items.title: Financial Update and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: CFO Bob Dickinson reported $21 million in certified free cash and an initial $1.1 million budget gap driven by rising GIC health insurance rates and pension obligations.

items.title: Budget Gap and Stabilization Fund Discussion
items.summary: Members discussed the transition of ARPA-funded positions to the general fund and debated whether the school stabilization 'ramp' funds should be considered part of the district's recurring base budget. The discussion clarified that closing the gap for level services citywide would require approximately $5 million beyond current revenue projections.
